spec_case: issue #579 (aliases of the CLI adapters), config errors
description: Every alias config error in one preflight failure, each naming its alias, in the order preflight reports adapters: an unknown base, a base that is itself an alias, an alias named like a built-in adapter (a CLI one and an API one), `env` that is not a mapping, a non-string `env` value and an invalid variable name. The error text carries no `env` value.
